title: Turn It Down, Please
desc: A polite way to ask your taxi driver to lower the music.

lines.en: You're in a Beijing taxi after a long flight. The driver loves loud music. You… don't. Here's how to fix that politely.
The music is blasting. Time for the key phrase: 把音乐关小一点儿 — turn the music down a little.

lines.hz: 师傅，请把音乐关小一点儿。
lines.py: shīfu, qǐng bǎ yīnyuè guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
lines.en: Driver, please turn the music down a bit.

lines.py: ò, duìbuqǐ! tài dà le shì ma?

lines.en: A little. I'd like to rest.

lines.py: méi wèntí. dào le wǒ jiào nǐ.
lines.en: No problem. I'll let you know when we arrive.
Polite and done. 关小 means 'turn down' — next time the karaoke's too loud, you know what to say.

title: Changing Subway Lines
desc: Which line, and where to transfer — the two questions every rider needs.

lines.en: The Beijing subway has more than twenty lines. Sooner or later you'll need to change. Here's how to ask.

lines.hz: 不好意思，去故宫坐几号线？
lines.py: bùhǎoyìsi, qù Gùgōng zuò jǐ hào xiàn?
lines.en: Excuse me, which line goes to the Forbidden City?

lines.py: zhèr shì yī hào xiàn ma?

lines.hz: 不是。你要先坐二号线，再换一号线。
lines.py: bù shì. nǐ yào xiān zuò èr hào xiàn, zài huàn yī hào xiàn.
lines.en: No. First take Line 2, then change to Line 1.

lines.py: bú kèqi. chē lái le, kuài shàng ba!
lines.en: You're welcome. The train's here — hop on!
换 means 'to change or switch'. 先…再… — 'first… then…' — is how every direction-giver will order your trip.

title: Ordering Noodles
desc: No English menu? No problem — order beef noodles like a local.

lines.en: You walk into a small noodle shop. There's no English menu and no pictures. This is all you need.
What would you like to eat?

lines.py: wǒ yào yì wǎn niúròu miàn.
lines.en: I'll have a bowl of beef noodles.
买单 — the two most useful characters in any restaurant. Literally 'buy the bill'. Shout it across the room; everyone does.

title: Open the Trunk!
desc: Three suitcases, one taxi, and a trunk that won't open itself.

lines.en: Three suitcases, one taxi, and a trunk that won't open itself. Time for the magic word 一下.
后备箱 is the trunk. And 开一下 — 'open a little' — is the softest way to ask anyone to do anything.

title: Checking In
desc: You booked online. Now prove it — in Chinese.

lines.en: You booked the room online days ago. Now you just have to prove it — in Chinese.

lines.py: nǐhǎo! yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng nǐ?
lines.en: Hi! How can I help you?

lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ dìng le yí ge fángjiān.
zhǎodào le. liǎng wǎn, duì ma?

lines.en: Right. Does the room have Wi-Fi?
Yes, the password is on the card.

lines.hz: 你的房间在八楼，电梯在左边。
lines.py: nǐ de fángjiān zài bā lóu, diàntī zài zuǒbiān.
lines.en: Your room is on the 8th floor; the elevator is on the left.
订 — to book. 找到了 — 'found it': you'll hear it every time a search succeeds anywhere in China.

title: Heat My Food, Please
desc: Convenience-store boxed meals, and the clerk who heats them for you.

lines.en: Chinese convenience stores sell fresh boxed meals — and the clerk will even heat them for you, if you ask.

lines.py: hǎo de. qǐng bāng wǒ rè yíxià.
lines.en: OK. Please heat it up for me.

lines.hz: 要，谢谢。再给我一个袋子。
lines.py: yào, xièxie. zài gěi wǒ yí ge dàizi.
lines.en: Yes, thanks. Also give me a bag.
热一下 — 'heat it a little'. The 一下 softens any request: 看一下, 等一下, 开一下. Collect them all.

title: Where's the Museum?
desc: Maps are great — until they aren't. Time to ask a human.

lines.en: Your map app just lost you in a hutong. Time to do it the old way — ask a human.
Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?

lines.py: wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.

lines.en: Not far — ten minutes on foot.
Do I cross the traffic light?

lines.py: yào. guò le dēng jiù néng kànjian.
lines.en: Yes. You'll see it right after the light.
往 + direction + 拐 — 'turn toward'. 往前走 — 'go forward': the start of every set of directions you'll ever get.

title: I Have a Cold
desc: Feeling sick abroad is the worst. Let's make it slightly less worst.

lines.en: Feeling sick abroad is the worst. Let's at least make the pharmacy part easy.
Hi, I feel a bit unwell.
I have a cold, and a headache too.

lines.py: zhège yào yì tiān chī sān cì.
lines.en: Take this medicine three times a day.

lines.py: fàn qián chī háishì fàn hòu chī?
fàn hòu chī. duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi.
lines.en: After meals. Drink lots of water and rest up.
感冒 — a cold. And 多喝水 — 'drink more water': China's answer to everything. Get well soon!

title: Looking for a Parking Space
desc: Ask before you circle the block forever.

lines.en: The mall is packed and every spot looks taken. Or is it? Ask before you circle forever.
Hi, are there any parking spots here?

lines.py: yǒu, B èr hái yǒu wèizi.

lines.en: 停车位 — parking spot. 满 — full. Two words you'll need every single weekend.

title: Buying High-Speed Train Tickets
desc: The best way to see China — but first, the ticket window.

lines.en: The high-speed rail is the best way to see China. First, you need a ticket.

lines.hz: 你好，买一张去上海的票。
lines.py: nǐhǎo, mǎi yì zhāng qù Shànghǎi de piào.
hǎo de. jǐ diǎn dào Shànghǎi?
lines.en: OK. What time does it reach Shanghai?

lines.py: wǔ diǎn bàn dào Hóngqiáo zhàn.

lines.en: 二等座 — second class. In China, second class is already nicer than most airplanes.

title: Chinese Breakfast
desc: Forget toast — a Chinese breakfast is a whole adventure for about a dollar.

lines.en: Forget toast and cereal. A Chinese breakfast is a whole adventure — and it costs about a dollar.

lines.py: yí ge bāozi, yì bēi dòujiāng.
lines.en: One baozi and a soy milk.

lines.py: tián de. zài jiā yì gēn yóutiáo.

lines.en: 油条 — the fried dough stick that goes with everything. And 扫码 — scan the code. Cash is ancient history.

title: Can I Have Your Phone Number?
desc: You met someone interesting. Don't let them walk away.

lines.en: You just met someone interesting. Don't let them walk away without a number.

lines.py: wǒ yěshì. xià cì zài chūlai wán?

lines.hz: 那……我可以要你的电话号码吗？
lines.py: nà…… wǒ kěyǐ yào nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
lines.en: Then… can I have your phone number?

lines.py: kěyǐ a. huòzhě jiā ge Wēixìn?
lines.en: Sure. Or add me on WeChat?
电话号码 — phone number. But honestly, the real question in China is 加个微信吗?

title: Exchanging Dollars for RMB
desc: The airport rate was terrible — here's how the bank works.

lines.en: The airport rate was terrible, so here you are at a real bank. Let's change some money.
Hi, I'd like to exchange money.

lines.hz: 五百美元。今天汇率是多少？
lines.py: wǔbǎi Měiyuán. jīntiān huìlǜ shì duōshao?
bú yòng. qǐng gěi wǒ hùzhào.

lines.en: 汇率 — exchange rate. 人民币 — RMB, 'the people's currency'. Bring your passport or go home.

title: Calling In Sick
desc: You feel awful and it's only Tuesday. Time for the call.

lines.en: You feel awful and it's only Tuesday. Time for the sick-day phone call.

lines.hz: 我今天不舒服，想请一天假。
lines.py: wǒ jīntiān bù shūfu, xiǎng qǐng yì tiān jià.
lines.en: I feel unwell today — I'd like a day off.

lines.py: yánzhòng ma? yào bú yào qù yīyuàn?
lines.en: Is it serious? Need the hospital?

lines.py: bù yánzhòng, xiūxi yíxià jiù hǎo.
hǎo, duō hē shuǐ. míngtiān jiàn.
lines.en: OK, drink water. See you tomorrow.
请假 — to ask for leave. The call every worker dreads, made easy.

title: Haircuts
desc: The scariest question in any language: 'How do you want it?'

lines.en: The scariest sentence in any language: 'How do you want it?' Here's your survival kit.
How do you want it cut?

lines.py: jiǎn duǎn yìdiǎnr, bié tài duǎn.

lines.en: 剪短 — cut short. 别太短 — 'not too short' is the most useful 别-sentence ever invented.

title: WeChat
desc: In China, WeChat isn't an app. It's the air people breathe.

lines.en: In China, WeChat isn't an app. It's the air people breathe. Let's get you set up.

lines.py: yòng a, měitiān dōu zài yòng.
wǒ gāng xiàzài, hái bú tài huì yòng.
hěn jiǎndān. xiān jiā wǒ hǎoyǒu.
lines.en: Easy. First add me as a friend.

lines.py: sǎo wǒ de èr-wéi-mǎ jiù xíng.

lines.hz: 可以发消息、付钱、打车，都可以。
lines.py: kěyǐ fā xiāoxi, fù qián, dǎchē, dōu kěyǐ.

lines.en: 二维码 — QR code. Welcome to Chinese life, now with one hundred percent more QR.

title: Going on a Picnic
desc: The forecast finally says 'nice'. Text your friend.

lines.en: The weather app finally says 'nice'. Time to text your friend — it's picnic time.

lines.hz: 明天天气很好，去野餐吗？
lines.py: míngtiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, qù yěcān ma?
kěyǐ. wǒ dài shuǐguǒ hé yǐnliào.
lines.en: Works. I'll bring fruit and drinks.
野餐 — picnic. 带 — to bring. Now you can plan a whole day in two texts.

title: Finding an Apartment
desc: Where 'cozy' means small and 'small' means closet.

lines.en: Apartment hunting in a Chinese city — where 'cozy' means small and 'small' means closet.

lines.py: xiǎng zhǎo shénme yàng de fángzi?
lines.en: What kind of place are you looking for?

lines.hz: 一室一厅，离地铁近一点。
lines.py: yì shì yì tīng, lí dìtiě jìn yìdiǎn.
lines.en: A one-bedroom, close to the subway.

lines.hz: 看起来不错。多少钱一个月？
lines.py: kàn qǐlai búcuò. duōshao qián yí ge yuè?
lines.en: Looks nice. How much per month?

lines.py: hǎo, shénme shíhou néng kàn fáng?
lines.en: OK. When can I see it?
一室一厅 — one bedroom plus living room. Always ask 能便宜一点吗 — always.

title: Can I See the Menu?
desc: The menu arrived and it's all Chinese. Breathe.

lines.en: The menu just arrived and it's all Chinese. No pictures either. Breathe.

lines.py: qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yíxià càidān.
lines.en: Can I see the menu, please?

lines.py: nà wǒ yào yí fèn kǎoyā.
lines.en: Then I'll have one order of duck.

lines.py: hǎo de, hái yào biéde ma?

lines.en: 菜单 — menu. 特色菜 — specialty. Point at what looks good, smile, and you're fed.

title: The Traffic Jam
desc: You left early and you're still going to be late. Welcome to rush hour.

lines.en: You left early and you're still going to be late. Welcome to rush hour.

lines.py: wǒ zuò dìtiě kěnéng gèng kuài.
lines.en: The subway might be faster for me.
Right, the station is just ahead.

lines.hz: 那我在这儿下吧，多少钱？
lines.py: nà wǒ zài zhèr xià ba, duōshao qián?
lines.en: I'll get out here then. How much?
堵车 — traffic jam. Literally 'blocked cars'. When you hear it, start walking.

title: We're Lost
desc: The map died, the alley splits three ways, and your friend is too calm.

lines.en: The map doesn't work, the alley splits three ways, and your Chinese friend is calm. Too calm.
We went the wrong way, right?

lines.py: bù zhīdào. wèn ge rén ba.

lines.hz: 你好，请问地铁站怎么走？
lines.py: nǐhǎo, qǐngwèn dìtiě zhàn zěnme zǒu?
lines.en: Hi, how do we get to the subway?

lines.py: tā shuō wǎng huí zǒu wǔbǎi mǐ.

lines.en: 走错 — go the wrong way. Admitting it is the first step back home.

title: Getting a Date
desc: Small talk worked. Now the scary part: asking them out.

lines.en: Small talk worked. Now comes the scary part: actually asking them out.

lines.hz: 小美，这个周末你有空吗？
lines.py: Xiǎo Měi, zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
lines.en: Xiao Mei, are you free this weekend?

lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ kàn diànyǐng.
lines.en: I'd like to take you to a movie.

lines.py: nà bù xīn de àiqíng piān.

lines.en: 有空 — free, available. 请你看电影 — 'invite you to a movie'. Smooth, simple, effective.

title: Having Food Delivered
desc: Dinner comes to you — the true miracle of modern China.

lines.en: Dinner is coming to you — the true miracle of modern China. Your phone just rang.

lines.py: wéi, nǐ de wàimài dào le.

lines.hz: 看到了，穿黑衣服的是你吗？
lines.py: kàndào le, chuān hēisè yīfu de shì nǐ ma?
lines.en: I see you — the one in black?
外卖 — delivery. 到了 — 'it has arrived': the best notification in the world.

title: How Cold Is It in Winter?
desc: 'A bit cold' in Beijing means minus ten. Check before you pack.

lines.en: Your friend says Beijing winters are 'a bit cold'. Check the number before you pack.

lines.hz: 冷！最冷的时候零下十度。
lines.py: lěng! zuì lěng de shíhou língxià shí dù.
lines.en: Cold! Coldest days hit minus ten.
Right, so wear a down jacket.

lines.hz: 那我得多带几件厚衣服。
lines.py: nà wǒ děi duō dài jǐ jiàn hòu yīfu.
lines.en: I should pack more warm clothes then.
零下 — below zero. 度 — degrees. When a Beijinger says 'a bit cold', bring the big coat.

title: Forks and Spoons
desc: Asking for a fork is 'giving up' — but sometimes you just need one.

lines.en: Asking for a fork in China is basically giving up. But a spoon for your soup? Always acceptable.

lines.py: kuàizi zhēnde bú huì yòng ma?

lines.en: 叉子 — fork. 勺子 — spoon. 筷子 — chopsticks. Collect all three, then level up.

title: Can I Eat With You?
desc: Every seat is taken. Time to make a lunch friend.

lines.en: The lunch rush is real: every table is taken. Time to make a lunch friend.
Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
Yeah, it's like this every day.

lines.hz: 你吃的什么？看起来不错。
lines.py: nǐ chī de shénme? kàn qǐlai búcuò.
lines.en: What are you eating? Looks good.

lines.py: niúròu miàn. nà jiā de zuì hǎochī.
lines.en: Beef noodles — that stall's are the best.

lines.py: nà wǒ xià cì yě shìshi.
lines.en: I'll try it next time then.
这儿有人吗 — 'is this seat taken?' The two-second friend-maker of every food court.

title: Can I Sit Here?
desc: The shortest social interaction in Chinese — and the most useful.

lines.en: First day of class and the room is full. You need a seat and a friend — one phrase gets both.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèr ma?
xièxie! nǐ yěshì xīn xuésheng ma?
lines.en: Thanks! Are you a new student too?
Yes, I just arrived last week.

lines.py: hěn hǎo, jiùshì shuō de tài kuài.

lines.en: 我可以坐这儿吗 — 'can I sit here?' The shortest social script in Chinese.

title: Big Numbers
desc: Ten thousand is one 万 — the number system that breaks brains.

lines.en: Chinese has a word for ten thousand — 万. English doesn't. That's why big numbers hurt.

lines.hz: 一万二？那是一万两千吗？
lines.py: yí wàn èr? nà shì yíwàn liǎngqiān ma?
lines.en: One wan two — is that twelve thousand?

lines.py: tài guì le! yǒu wǔ wàn de chē ma?
lines.en: Too expensive! Is there a 50k car?
万 — ten thousand. 一万二 — 'one wan two' = 12,000. Think in wans and numbers stop hurting.

title: Words of Encouragement
desc: Your friend is about to quit. Two characters fix everything: 加油.

lines.en: Your friend is about to give up. Two characters fix everything.

lines.hz: 中文太难了，我不想学了。
lines.py: Zhōngwén tài nán le, wǒ bù xiǎng xué le.
lines.en: Chinese is too hard — I want to quit.

lines.hz: 别这么说！你已经很棒了。
lines.py: bié zhème shuō! nǐ yǐjīng hěn bàng le.
lines.en: Don't say that! You're already great.

lines.py: dànshì wǒ kǎoshì yòu méi guò.
lines.en: But I failed the test again.

lines.hz: 没关系，下次一定行。加油！
lines.py: méiguānxi, xià cì yídìng xíng. jiāyóu!
lines.en: It's OK — next time for sure. Jiayou!
加油 — literally 'add oil', China's all-purpose 'you got this'. Works for exams, marathons, and Mondays.

title: Photocopying and Printing
desc: The copy shop on the corner saves visas, jobs, and school applications.

lines.en: The little copy shop on the corner saves visas, job applications, and grades every day.
Hi, I need to make copies.

lines.py: zhè fèn wénjiàn, yìn shí fèn.
hēibái de. hái néng dǎyìn ma?
lines.en: Black and white. Can you print too?

lines.py: néng, fā dào yóuxiāng jiù xíng.

lines.en: 复印 — photocopy. 打印 — print. 份 — copy/portion. Same character for noodles and paperwork.

title: Finding the Office Building
desc: Three identical towers and your meeting starts in ten minutes.

lines.en: Three identical towers, one address, and your meeting starts in ten minutes.

lines.hz: 你好，请问华贸中心怎么走？
lines.py: nǐhǎo, qǐngwèn Huámào Zhōngxīn zěnme zǒu?
lines.en: Hi, how do I get to Huamao Center?

lines.py: nǎ yí zuò? A zuò háishi B zuò?
B zuò zài yòubiān, jìnmén yào dēngjì.
lines.en: B is on the right — sign in at the door.
座 — the measure word for towers. 登记 — sign in. Big buildings have rules; now you know them.

title: Buying a Prepaid Phone Card
desc: No phone, no life. The corner store can fix that in two minutes.

lines.en: No phone credit means no maps, no WeChat, no life. The corner store can fix that.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, yǒu shǒujī chōngzhí kǎ ma?
lines.en: Hi, do you have phone top-up cards?

lines.py: yǒu, yào duō dà miànzhí de?

lines.hz: 哪个运营商？移动还是联通？
lines.py: nǎ ge yùnyíngshāng? Yídòng háishi Liántōng?
Yídòng. néng bāng wǒ chōng yíxià ma?
lines.en: Mobile. Can you top it up for me?

lines.py: hǎo le, shōudào duǎnxìn le. xièxie!

lines.en: 充值 — top up. 面值 — face value. Your phone is alive again.

title: Restaurant Recommendation
desc: Ask a local where to eat — never a wrong answer.

lines.en: Review apps can't be trusted. The best restaurant guide is a hungry local.

lines.py: zhè fùjìn yǒu shénme hǎochī de?
lines.en: Anything good to eat around here?
Love it — the spicier the better.

lines.hz: 那去吃火锅吧，前面那家很有名。
lines.py: nà qù chī huǒguō ba, qiánmiàn nà jiā hěn yǒumíng.
lines.en: Go for hotpot — the place ahead is famous.

lines.py: rén duō ma? yào páiduì ma?
lines.en: Is it crowded? Need to queue?
A short wait — but worth it.
推荐 — recommend. 值得 — worth it. The spicier the better: 越辣越好.

title: Directions for the Taxi Driver
desc: The driver doesn't know your hostel. You'd better know your lefts and rights.

lines.en: The driver doesn't know your little hostel. Now your lefts and rights really matter.
OK. How do I go once there?

lines.hz: 一直往前，第二个红绿灯往左拐。
lines.py: yìzhí wǎng qián, dì-èr ge hónglǜdēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi.
lines.en: Straight ahead — left at the second light.

lines.hz: 再走一百米，右边有个小胡同。
lines.py: zài zǒu yìbǎi mǐ, yòubiān yǒu ge xiǎo hútòng.
lines.en: Another hundred meters — a small hutong on the right.

lines.py: hǎo, kàndào le. jiù zài zhèr tíng?

lines.en: 一直往前 — straight ahead. 往左拐 — turn left. You just navigated like a local.

title: Getting to the Office
desc: First day at work and the bus just left without you.

lines.en: First day at the new job — and the bus just left without you.

lines.py: zài dìtiě shàng, hái yǒu liǎng zhàn.
lines.en: On the subway — two stops away.
How do I get there from the subway?

lines.py: C chūkǒu, zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
lines.en: Exit C — five minutes on foot.
出口 — exit. 等 — to wait. Day one saved.

title: Afternoon Meeting
desc: Two o'clock, third floor conference room — don't be late.

lines.en: Your first Chinese meeting. Learn the logistics first; the opinions can wait.

lines.py: xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kāihuì, bié wàng le.
dài shàng ge yuè de bàogào jiù xíng.

lines.en: 会议室 — meeting room. 左右 — 'about'. 一个小时左右 — about an hour. Use it everywhere.

title: Getting an Official Receipt
desc: The magic word for expense claims: 发票.

lines.en: Your company pays for the meal — but only if you bring back the magic paper: the fapiao.
Can I get an official receipt?
Sure — what name for the header?

lines.py: xiě gōngsī míng, wǒ fā gěi nǐ.
lines.en: The company name — I'll send it to you.

lines.py: hǎo, diànzǐ fāpiào fā nǐ yóuxiāng.

lines.en: 发票 — the official tax receipt. 抬头 — the name on it. No fapiao, no reimbursement. Ever.

title: Choosing a Room
desc: Big bed or two singles? Smoking or not? Now you can answer.

lines.en: 'What kind of room would you like?' — four ways to answer that question like a pro.

lines.py: dà chuáng fáng, ānjìng yìdiǎn de.
lines.en: A queen-bed room, on the quiet side.

lines.py: yào gāocéng de háishi dīcéng de?

lines.hz: 高层的，谢谢。能看风景吗？
lines.py: gāocéng de, xièxie. néng kàn fēngjǐng ma?
néng, zhè jiān kěyǐ kàndào jiāng.
lines.en: Yes — this one faces the river.

lines.py: tài hǎo le, jiù zhè jiān.

lines.hz: 好，含早餐，明天七点到十点。
lines.py: hǎo, hán zǎocān, míngtiān qī diǎn dào shí diǎn.

lines.en: 大床房 — queen-bed room. 间 — the measure word for rooms. View upgrade: free.

title: Hotel Room Cleaning
desc: Knock knock — housekeeping. What do you even say?

lines.en: Knock knock — housekeeping. Do you want it now, later, or never? Pick a line.

lines.hz: 您好，现在可以打扫房间吗？
lines.py: nínhǎo, xiànzài kěyǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān ma?
lines.en: Hello, can I clean the room now?

lines.hz: 可以等一下吗？我十分钟后走。
lines.py: kěyǐ děng yíxià ma? wǒ shí fēnzhōng hòu zǒu.
lines.en: Can you wait? I leave in ten minutes.

lines.py: hǎo de, wǒ yìhuìr zài lái.
kěyǐ duō gěi liǎng tiáo máojīn ma?
lines.en: Could I get two extra towels?

lines.py: méi wèntí. hái yào biéde ma?
zài yào liǎng píng shuǐ, xièxie.
lines.en: Two more bottles of water, thanks.
打扫 — clean. 毛巾 — towel. 一会儿 — 'in a bit'. The most useful small unit of time.

title: Buying a Handbag
desc: The price is flexible. The question is whether you are.

lines.en: The market price is flexible. The question is whether you are. Time to bargain.
Boss, how much is this bag?

lines.py: tài guì le ba! piányi diǎn.

lines.en: Then how much do you say?

lines.py: sānbǎi bù xíng, liùbǎi, zuìdī le.

lines.en: 400 — if that's OK, I'll take it.

lines.py: xíng xíng xíng, gěi nǐ le.

lines.en: 便宜点 — 'a little cheaper'. Start low, meet in the middle. That's the game.

title: Slippers, Toothbrush and Toothpaste
desc: The hostel forgot your amenities. Ask for all three in one breath.

lines.en: Your room has everything except the three things you actually need. Ask for all three in one breath.
Hi, my room has no slippers.
Sorry, I'll bring some right away.

lines.hz: 都要吗？我们有一次性的。
lines.py: dōu yào ma? wǒmen yǒu yícìxìng de.
lines.en: Need both? We have disposable ones.

lines.hz: 都要，谢谢。还要一个吹风机。
lines.py: dōu yào, xièxie. hái yào yí ge chuīfēngjī.
lines.en: All of them, thanks. Plus a hairdryer.

lines.py: hǎo, wǔ fēnzhōng hòu sòng dào.

lines.en: 拖鞋 — slippers. 牙刷 toothpaste is 牙膏, don't mix them up — toothpaste on your feet won't help anyone.

title: China Union Pay
desc: Your foreign card says 'declined'. Now what?

lines.en: Your foreign card just got declined. In China, there's a backup plan — and a magic app.

lines.py: bù xíng. shǒujī zhīfù kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: No. Can you pay by phone?
银联 — UnionPay, China's card network. 刷 — to swipe. When in doubt, scan the code.

title: Dental Floss
desc: Something's stuck in your teeth and the pharmacy clerk is watching.

lines.en: Something's stuck in your teeth and you need the weird little string. Here's how to ask.
Hi, do you have dental floss?

lines.py: yǒu dài bǎ de nà zhǒng ma?
yǒu zhège, yì bāo wǔshí ge.

lines.en: 牙线 — literally 'tooth thread'. Once you see it, you can't unsee it — and you'll never forget it.

title: Scheduling a Time
desc: 'When are you free?' — the question behind every plan in China.

lines.en: Every plan in China starts with one question: when are you free? Learn to answer it.

lines.hz: 周三不行，我要上班。周四呢？
lines.py: zhōusān bù xíng, wǒ yào shàngbān. zhōusì ne?
lines.en: Wednesday's no good — I work. Thursday?

lines.py: xíng, jiù zhōusì xiàwǔ sān diǎn.

lines.en: 有空 — free. 不行 — 'doesn't work'. Two words that run every Chinese calendar.

title: Making Plans for the Day
desc: What are we doing today? Now you can answer in Chinese.

lines.en: The day's wide open and your friend just asked the dangerous question: what's the plan?
Museum in the morning — sound good?

lines.hz: 附近有家店，面条很好吃。
lines.py: fùjìn yǒu jiā diàn, miàntiáo hěn hǎochī.
lines.en: There's a good noodle place nearby.

lines.hz: 去公园走走，然后喝咖啡。
lines.py: qù gōngyuán zǒuzou, ránhòu hē kāfēi.
lines.en: Walk in the park, then coffee.
先……然后 — first… then. The two-step planning formula that makes any day yours.

title: Favorite Sports
desc: The universal icebreaker — now in Chinese.

lines.en: Sports talk works in every language. Learn your favorites — and one polite lie for the rest.

lines.py: wǒ xǐhuan tī zúqiú, nǐ ne?
wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú hé yóuyǒng.

lines.hz: 会一点儿。中国人都会打吧！
lines.py: huì yìdiǎnr. Zhōngguó rén dōu huì dǎ ba!
lines.en: A little. All Chinese people can, right?!
打 — play (ball sports with hands). 踢 — kick. 游 — swim. Each sport gets its own verb.

title: Plane Ticket Prices
desc: Two thousand kuai?! Learn to ask for the cheaper flight.

lines.en: Two thousand kuai for one hour in the air. Time to hunt for a cheaper seat.

lines.hz: 你好，去成都的机票多少钱？
lines.py: nǐhǎo, qù Chéngdū de jīpiào duōshao qián?
lines.en: Hi, how much is a flight to Chengdu?
直飞 — direct flight. 转机 — connect. Cheap or fast — pick your pain.

title: Online Shopping Help
desc: Your package went 'on a trip'. Customer service time.

lines.en: Your package has been 'traveling' for two weeks. Time to call customer service.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ de kuàidì hái méi dào.
nín de dìngdān hào shì duōshao?
yī èr sān sì wǔ liù.
hǎo ba, nà wǒ zài děngdeng.

lines.en: 快递 — express package. 在路上 — 'on the road', the answer you'll hear forever.

title: Where in Shanghai
desc: A city of 26 million — learn to say which corner is yours.

lines.en: Twenty-six million people, one question: where in the city do you live?
Where in Shanghai do you live?

lines.hz: 那边很方便！离地铁近吗？
lines.py: nàbiān hěn fāngbiàn! lí dìtiě jìn ma?
lines.en: So convenient! Close to the subway?
Do you go to the Bund often?

lines.py: bú tài qù, rén tài duō le.

lines.en: 住 — live. 附近 — nearby. 走路五分钟 — '5 minutes on foot', the universal distance.

title: Help with Luggage
desc: Your bag weighs 30 kilos and the stairs just kept going.

lines.en: Your bag weighs thirty kilos and the stairs keep going. Accept help — gracefully.

lines.py: nǐ de xiāngzi hǎo zhòng a.

lines.en: No wonder! Which floor do you live on?
怪不得 — 'no wonder'. The perfect response when something suddenly makes sense.

title: Workout Frequency at the Gym
desc: Someone asked how often you work out. Lie responsibly.

lines.en: Someone at the gym asked how often you train. Lie responsibly — with correct grammar.

lines.py: nǐ yì zhōu lái jǐ cì?
lines.en: How many times a week do you come?

lines.py: wǒ měitiān dōu lái, zhǔyào liàn xiōng.

lines.en: 次 — times. 一周三次 — three times a week. The grammar of flexing.

title: Sending a Text Message
desc: Why isn't he replying? Maybe the message never sent.

lines.en: You texted an hour ago and got nothing. Maybe the message never sent.

lines.py: nǐ shōudào wǒ de xiāoxi le ma?
méiyǒu a, nǐ fā le shénme?
wǒ yí ge xiǎoshí qián fā de.
lines.en: I sent it an hour ago.

lines.py: qíguài. nǐ zài fā yí cì?
hǎo…… fā hǎo le, shōudào ma?
shōudào le! wǎnshang qī diǎn jiàn.
lines.en: Got it! See you at seven.
发 — send. 收到 — 'received'. The two-step proof your message landed.

title: Ice Cream Run
desc: Two scoops, one decision: cone or cup?

lines.en: It's hot, you found the ice cream stand, and there's one last decision: cone or cup.
Hi, what flavors do you have?

lines.hz: 香草、巧克力、抹茶和芒果。
我要巧克力和抹茶，两个球。
lines.py: wǒ yào qiǎokèlì hé mǒchá, liǎng ge qiú.

lines.en: 球 — scoop (literally 'ball'). 筒 — cone. Two scoops of vocabulary, no brain freeze.

title: Baijiu or Beer
desc: At a Chinese dinner, 'just a little' means you're about to drink a lot.

lines.en: At a Chinese business dinner, 'just a little' means you're about to drink a lot. Choose wisely.

lines.hz: 来，喝点什么？白酒还是啤酒？
lines.py: lái, hē diǎn shénme? báijiǔ háishi píjiǔ?
lines.en: Come — what'll you drink? Baijiu or beer?

lines.py: píjiǔ ba, báijiǔ tài liè le.

lines.en: Just a small cup, try it!
Haha, you get used to it!
干杯 — literally 'dry the glass'. 烈 — strong/liquor-strong. Pace yourself out there.

title: Asking Height and Weight
desc: Chinese asks about your body stats like it's the weather. Roll with it.

lines.en: In China, people ask your height and weight like they ask about the weather. Roll with it.
Young man, how tall are you?
So tall! How much do you weigh?

lines.py: tài shòu le! duō chī diǎn fàn.

lines.en: 多高 — how tall. 多重 — how heavy. And whatever you weigh, an auntie will say you're too thin.

title: Getting Picked Up by a Driver
desc: Your ride says 'I'm outside'. Find the right gray car.

lines.en: Your DiDi says 'I'm outside' — and so are forty other gray cars. Confirm before you climb in.

lines.py: wéi, wǒ dào le, zài ménkǒu.
lines.en: Hi, I'm here — at the gate.

lines.py: hǎo, nǐ de chē shì shénme yánsè?
lines.en: OK — what color is your car?

lines.py: báisè, chēpái shì Jīng A yī-èr-sān-sì-wǔ.
kàndào le! shì qù jīchǎng de ma?
lines.en: I see it! Are you going to the airport?
车牌 — license plate. 尾号 — last digits of your phone. Check both before you get in.

title: Which Hilton?
desc: The city has three Hiltons and you're at the wrong one.

lines.en: You walked into the lobby confident — and the computer says your booking is somewhere else entirely.

lines.hz: 抱歉，找不到。您订的是哪家希尔顿？
lines.py: bàoqiàn, zhǎo bú dào. nín dìng de shì nǎ jiā Xīěrdùn?
lines.en: Sorry, not found. Which Hilton did you book?

lines.py: a? yǒu hǎo jǐ jiā ma?

lines.hz: 有三家。机场店、河边店和这家。
lines.py: yǒu sān jiā. jīchǎng diàn, hébiān diàn hé zhè jiā.
lines.en: Three. Airport, riverside, and this one.
家 — measure word for businesses. Always confirm WHICH branch — chains multiply when you travel.

title: Checking Out at a Hotel
desc: Pack your bags, count the minibar damage, and hand back the key card.

lines.en: Pack your bags, count the minibar damage, and hand back the key card.
Hi, I'd like to check out.

lines.hz: 您用了小吧台的东西吗？
lines.py: nín yòng le xiǎo bātái de dōngxi ma?
lines.en: Did you use anything from the minibar?
I drank one bottle of water.

lines.hz: 好，加十块。一共一千二百一十。
lines.py: hǎo, jiā shí kuài. yígòng yìqiān èrbǎi yīshí.

lines.en: 退房 — check out. 小吧台 — minibar. That ten-kuai water was never free.

title: Sleepy
desc: Jet lag at 3 PM. Survive the afternoon in Chinese.

lines.en: Jet lag hits at 3 PM like a truck. Survive the afternoon — in Chinese.

lines.py: nǐ zěnme le? kàn qǐlai hěn kùn.
zuówǎn méi shuì hǎo, dǎo shíchā.

lines.en: 困 — sleepy. 倒时差 — jet lag. 才 — 'only then' for painfully late times.

title: Rice First
desc: In China, the rice comes last — and nobody told you.

lines.en: You ate all the dishes and wondered where the rice was. In China, rice comes last.

lines.hz: 我们的米饭怎么还没来？
lines.py: wǒmen de mǐfàn zěnme hái méi lái?
xiān chī cài, chī bǎo le zài chī fàn.
lines.en: Eat dishes first — rice fills you up last.

lines.hz: 有意思。那我不点米饭了。
lines.py: yǒu yìsi. nà wǒ bù diǎn mǐfàn le.
lines.en: Interesting. Then I won't order rice.
最后 — last. 先……再 — first… then. Now the rice mystery is solved forever.

title: No Hot Water
desc: The shower is freezing and so is your patience. Call the front desk.

lines.en: The shower is freezing and so is your patience. Time to call the front desk.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ fángjiān méiyǒu rè shuǐ.
lines.en: Hi, my room has no hot water.
How long did you run it?

lines.py: shí fēnzhōng le, hái shì liáng de.
wǎng zuǒbiān zhuàn, děng wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Turn it left and wait five minutes.

lines.py: bàoqiàn, wǒ mǎshàng jiào rén qù kàn.
lines.en: Sorry — sending someone up right away.
热水 — hot water. 没热水 is also what you say at a restaurant when you want… hot water to drink.

title: Movie Theater Seats
desc: 7F or G7? Decode your ticket before the lights go out.

lines.en: Row seven, seat F — or is it F row, seven seat? Decode your ticket before the lights go out.
Two tickets for The Wandering Earth.

lines.py: dì-qī pái zhōngjiān de kěyǐ ma?
wǎnshang qī diǎn bàn, sān hào tīng.

lines.en: 排 — row. 号 — number. 厅 — hall. Read the ticket: 7排8号 = row 7, seat 8.

title: Tea Refill
desc: Your teapot is empty. In China, the refill is free — if you know the move.

lines.en: Your teapot just ran dry. Good news: the refill is free — if you know the move.

lines.hz: 服务员，茶没了，能加点儿吗？
lines.py: fúwùyuán, chá méi le, néng jiā diǎnr ma?
lines.en: Waiter, the tea's gone — can you refill it?

lines.py: zhège chá zhēn xiāng, shì shénme chá?
lines.en: This tea is fragrant — what is it?

lines.hz: 茉莉花茶，我们店的招牌。
lines.py: mòlìhuā chá, wǒmen diàn de zhāopái.

lines.en: 加水 — add water. Leave the lid off the teapot and the refill just appears — locals' magic trick.

title: Annoying Ringtone
desc: Someone's phone keeps ringing. Say something polite — then say it louder.

lines.en: That phone has rung four times in ten minutes. Say something — politely at first.

lines.hz: 不好意思，您的手机一直在响。
lines.py: bùhǎoyìsi, nín de shǒujī yìzhí zài xiǎng.
lines.en: Excuse me, your phone keeps ringing.
Could you put it on silent?
静音 — silent mode. 响 — to ring. The polite '不好意思' does all the heavy lifting.

title: Switching Seats on a Plane
desc: You're in the middle seat. Negotiate your way out — politely.

lines.en: You're sandwiched in the middle seat. The aisle seat looks free — negotiate.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, nà shì nǐ de zuòwèi ma?
duì, kào guòdào de. zěnme le?

lines.hz: 我能跟你换一下吗？我想靠过道。
lines.py: wǒ néng gēn nǐ huàn yíxià ma? wǒ xiǎng kào guòdào.
lines.en: Can we switch? I'd like the aisle.

lines.hz: 不好意思，我喜欢靠过道。
没关系。你是去上海出差吗？
lines.py: méiguānxi. nǐ shì qù Shànghǎi chūchāi ma?
lines.en: No worries. Are you going to Shanghai for work?

lines.py: duì, měi zhōu dōu qù. nǐ ne?

lines.en: 靠窗 — window seat. 靠过道 — aisle seat. 换 — to swap. Even a 'no' ends with a friend.

title: Turn in Your Homework
desc: The dog didn't eat your homework — but the excuse needs Chinese.

lines.en: The homework deadline was yesterday. Time to face the teacher — with a good excuse or none.

lines.py: duìbùqǐ lǎoshī, wǒ wàng le dài.
lines.en: Sorry teacher, I forgot to bring it.

lines.py: yòu wàng le? shàng cì yěshì.
lines.en: Forgot again? Same as last time.

lines.hz: 这次真的写完了，明天一定交。
lines.py: zhè cì zhēnde xiě wán le, míngtiān yídìng jiāo.
lines.en: I really finished it — I'll hand it in tomorrow.

lines.py: hǎo ba, zuìhòu yí cì jīhuì.
xièxie lǎoshī! bú huì zài wàng le.
lines.en: Thank you! It won't happen again.
作业 — homework. 交 — to hand in. 又忘了 — 'forgot AGAIN', the word you never want to hear.

title: Changing Class Time
desc: Tuesday no longer works. Reschedule without losing your teacher.

lines.en: Tuesday no longer works — new job, new schedule. Reschedule without losing your teacher.

lines.hz: 老师，下周二的课我能换一下吗？
lines.py: lǎoshī, xià zhōu'èr de kè wǒ néng huàn yíxià ma?
lines.en: Teacher, can I change next Tuesday's class?

lines.py: kěyǐ, nǐ xiǎng huàn dào nǎ tiān?
lines.en: Sure — which day do you want?

lines.py: zhōusì wǒ shí diǎn yǒu kòng.
tài hǎo le, jiù shí diǎn.
hǎo, wǒ gěi nǐ gǎi yíxià.
lines.en: OK, I'll change it for you.
换 — to change/swap. 改 — to modify. Same 'move a thing' energy as the airplane seat.

title: How to Address Someone
desc: Sir? Uncle? Teacher? Every Chinese stranger needs a different name.

lines.en: Sir, uncle, teacher, boss — every Chinese stranger needs a different name. Here's the map.

lines.py: jiào wǒ Lǎo Wáng jiù xíng.
hǎo de Lǎo Wáng. nà nín tàitai ne?
lines.en: OK, Old Wang. And your wife?

lines.py: tā xìng Chén, jiào tā Chén Jiě ba.
lines.en: Her surname is Chen — call her Sister Chen.
老+姓 — 'Old' + surname for peers. 小+姓 — 'Little' + surname for juniors. Instant insider status.

title: Where's the Soap?
desc: Hands covered in dumpling sauce and the sink is suspiciously empty.

lines.en: Your hands are covered in dumpling sauce and the bathroom sink is suspiciously empty.
End of the hallway, on the right.

lines.hz: 啊，我忘了！用洗手液吧，在架子上。
lines.py: a, wǒ wàng le! yòng xǐshǒuyè ba, zài jiàzi shàng.
lines.en: Ah, I forgot! Use the hand soap — on the shelf.
肥皂 — bar soap. 洗手液 — liquid soap. Two different words for two different soaps.

title: Preparing for the HSK
desc: The exam is in three months and your vocab deck says otherwise.

lines.en: The exam is in three months and your vocabulary says 'three years'. Time for a plan.

lines.py: nǐ bào le HSK jǐ jí?
lines.en: Which HSK level did you register for?

lines.hz: 我过了三级。你怎么准备？
lines.py: wǒ guò le sān jí. nǐ zěnme zhǔnbèi?
lines.en: I passed level 3. How are you preparing?

lines.py: tīnglì ne? nà ge zuì nán.
hǎo xíguàn! nǐ kěndìng néng guò.

lines.en: 考过 — 'passed by taking'. The 过 means the experience is done and survived. Like this podcast.

title: This Needs to Be Dry Cleaned
desc: Wine on the white shirt — and the label says 'dry clean only'.

lines.en: Red wine on a white shirt, and the label says 'dry clean only'. To the shop.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, zhè jiàn chènshān yào gānxǐ.
lines.en: Hi, this shirt needs dry cleaning.

lines.hz: 有个酒渍，能洗掉，但是不能保证。
lines.py: yǒu ge jiǔzì, néng xǐdiào, dànshì bù néng bǎozhèng.
lines.en: There's a wine stain — we can try, no guarantee.
That's fine, try it. How much?
When can I pick it up?
干洗 — dry clean. 后天 — the day after tomorrow. 取 — pick up. Three words that save your wardrobe.

title: Skincare: Moisturizing Cream
desc: Beijing winter is eating your face. The pharmacy has answers.

lines.en: Beijing winter is eating your face. The cosmetics counter has answers — learn to ask for them.

lines.hz: 你好，我皮肤很干，有保湿霜吗？
lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ pífū hěn gān, yǒu bǎoshī shuāng ma?
lines.en: Hi, my skin is very dry — any moisturizer?

lines.py: yǒu, zhè yì kuǎn hěn shòu huānyíng.
lines.en: Yes — this one is very popular.
Is it good for sensitive skin?

lines.py: yǒu, zài pángbiān nà ge jiàzi.
lines.en: Yes — on the shelf beside it.
皮肤 — skin. 保湿 — moisturize. Your face is saved; your wallet is not.

title: I Want an Electric Scooter!
desc: Every local has one. Time to join the silent swarm.

lines.en: Every local zips past you on one. Silent, fast, and it never sits in traffic. Time to join the swarm.

lines.hz: 老板，我想买一辆电动车。
lines.py: lǎobǎn, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí liàng diàndòngchē.
lines.en: Boss, I want to buy an e-scooter.
How far do you need it to go?

lines.hz: 这款能跑四十公里，三千二。
lines.py: zhè kuǎn néng pǎo sìshí gōnglǐ, sānqiān èr.

lines.en: How long does the battery take to charge?

lines.py: liù ge xiǎoshí, wǎnshang chōng zhènghǎo.

lines.en: 辆 — measure word for vehicles. 公里 — kilometer. 骑 — to ride. Welcome to the swarm.

title: Fasten That Seatbelt
desc: Your driver says 安全带 — and he means right now.

lines.en: The driver just said something fast and pointed at your chest. He means the seatbelt.

lines.py: ò, hǎo de, jì hǎo le.

lines.hz: 后排也要系，最近查得严。
lines.py: hòupái yě yào jì, zuìjìn chá de yán.
lines.en: Back seat too — they've been checking lately.
安全带 — 'safety belt'. 系 — to fasten. 罚款 — a fine. Two hundred reasons to click.

title: Help Calling a Cab
desc: Raining, no umbrella, no ride-hailing app. The hotel concierge is your hero.

lines.en: It's raining, you have no umbrella, and no ride-hailing app. The concierge is your hero tonight.

lines.hz: 你好，能帮我叫一辆车吗？
lines.py: nǐhǎo, néng bāng wǒ jiào yí liàng chē ma?
lines.en: Hi, could you call me a car?
OK — it'll arrive in ten minutes.
叫车 — call a car. 打表 — 'run the meter'. Two phrases that get you home in the rain.

title: Can't Get a Taxi
desc: Rush hour, raining, zero taxis. Every driver's answer: 不走.

lines.en: Rush hour, raining, and every taxi that slows down drives off again. Learn the rejection words.

lines.hz: 又来一辆……师傅，去机场吗？
lines.py: yòu lái yí liàng…… shīfu, qù jīchǎng ma?

lines.hz: 半小时了，一辆都打不到！
lines.py: bàn xiǎoshí le, yí liàng dōu dǎ bú dào!
lines.en: Half an hour — can't get a single cab!

lines.py: xiǎohuǒzi, zuò dìtiě ba, gèng kuài.
lines.en: Young man, take the subway — faster.
交班 — shift change. 打不到车 — 'can't catch a cab'. When all else fails: the subway.

title: A Stroll Through the Hutongs
desc: Old Beijing's alleys — get lost on purpose this time.

lines.en: The guidebooks all say 'wander the hutongs'. So let's wander — this time getting lost on purpose.

lines.py: dàye, zhè tiáo hútòng néng zǒu ma?
lines.en: Sir, can I walk down this hutong?
Yes — through it is Houhai lake.

lines.hz: 这些院子真老，有多少年了？
lines.py: zhèxiē yuànzi zhēn lǎo, yǒu duōshao nián le?
lines.en: These courtyards are old — how many years?

lines.hz: 两三百年吧，我们家就住了一百多年。
lines.py: liǎng sān bǎi nián ba, wǒmen jiā jiù zhù le yìbǎi duō nián.
lines.en: Two-three hundred. My family's lived here over a hundred.
Wow — can I go in and look?

lines.py: bù xíng, zhè shì sīrén de.

lines.en: 胡同 — hutong alley. 院子 — courtyard. 大爷 — the respectful way to greet Beijing's elders.

title: Set the Alarm Clock
desc: 6 AM flight, and you trust your phone but not yourself.

lines.en: 6 AM flight. You trust your phone's alarm — but never fully. Double coverage it is.

lines.py: nǐ míngtiān jǐ diǎn de fēijī?
zǎoshang liù diǎn, děi sì diǎn qǐ.
lines.en: 6 AM — have to get up at four.

lines.hz: 定了，三点半和三点四十五。
lines.py: dìng le, sān diǎn bàn hé sān diǎn sìshíwǔ.
liǎng ge? nǐ pà qǐ bù lái?
duì, wù le fēijī jiù máfan le.
lines.en: Yes — missing the flight would be trouble.

lines.py: nà nǐ zǎo diǎn shuì ba, wǎn'ān!

lines.en: 闹钟 — alarm clock. 误 — to miss (a flight/train). Double alarms: the universal travel anxiety cure.

title: An Email Introduction
desc: The colleague you're meeting Friday — introduce yourself first.

lines.en: You're emailing a Chinese colleague you've never met. First impressions still matter — in writing.

lines.hz: 你看看：“王经理您好，我是新同事大卫。”
lines.py: nǐ kànkan: “Wáng jīnglǐ nínhǎo, wǒ shì xīn tóngshì Dàwèi.”
lines.en: Read it: 'Hello Manager Wang, I'm the new colleague David.'

lines.py: “zhōuwǔ de huìyì, wǒ huì zhǔnshí dào.”
lines.en: 'For Friday's meeting, I'll be on time.'
Add 'looking forward to working with you'.

lines.py: hǎo, zhèyàng jiù gèng zhèngshì le.

lines.en: 经理 — manager. 期待 — look forward to. 正式 — formal. One sentence upgrades any email.

title: Transportation Card
desc: One card for subway, bus and even the corner store. Get one.

lines.en: One card for subway, bus, and sometimes even the convenience store. You need this card.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, jiāotōng kǎ zài nǎr bàn?
lines.en: Hi, where do I get a transit card?

lines.hz: 二十块押金，退卡时还你。
lines.py: èrshí kuài yājīn, tuì kǎ shí hái nǐ.
lines.en: 20 kuai deposit — returned when you return it.
Then top it up with a hundred.

lines.py: hǎo le, gōngjiāo dìtiě dōu néng shuā.
lines.en: Done — works on bus and subway.
押金 — deposit. 充 — top up. 刷 — tap/swipe. Your whole city's transport in one little card.

title: Politely Declining an Invitation
desc: KTV night again — and you just can't. Say no without saying no.

lines.en: KTV night number four this week — and you just can't. Say no without ever saying 'no'.

lines.py: jīnwǎn qù KTV, yìqǐ lái ba!
jīntiān kǒngpà bù xíng, wǒ yǒu shì.
lines.en: Probably can't today — I have something on.

lines.hz: 真的不好意思，下次一定去。
lines.py: zhēnde bùhǎoyìsi, xià cì yídìng qù.
lines.en: Really sorry — next time for sure.
恐怕 — 'afraid (that)'. 下次一定 — 'next time for sure'. The soft no is an art form.

title: Going to the Gas Station
desc: Fill her up — and learn the two numbers that matter.

lines.en: The tank is empty and the gauge agrees. Two numbers matter at a Chinese gas station.
加满 — fill it up. 号 — grade number. 油箱 — fuel tank. Empty tank, full vocabulary.

title: Asking About What to Wear
desc: The invitation says 'dinner'. But what do Chinese dinners wear?

lines.en: The invitation says 'dinner' — but what does a Chinese dinner wear? Ask before you overdress.

lines.py: míngtiān de fànjú yào chuān shénme?
lines.en: What should I wear to tomorrow's dinner?

lines.py: nà chuān chènshān ba, bié chuān T-xù.
bú yòng, gānjìng zhěngjié jiù xíng.
hǎo, nà wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.

lines.en: 饭局 — dinner engagement. 别 — 'don't'. The simplest two-character dress code: 别穿T恤.

title: Wrong Way on the Subway
desc: Four stops in the wrong direction. Ask before you get off again.

lines.en: The stop names are getting more unfamiliar, not less. You went the wrong way.

lines.hz: 这趟车是往市中心方向吗？
lines.py: zhè tàng chē shì wǎng shì zhōngxīn fāngxiàng ma?
lines.en: Is this train going toward downtown?
No — this is the opposite direction.

lines.hz: 没事，下一站下车，对面就是回程。
lines.py: méishì, xià yí zhàn xià chē, duìmiàn jiùshì huíchéng.
lines.en: It's OK — get off next stop, the return is opposite.

lines.py: xièxie nǐ! wǒ duō zuò le sì zhàn.
lines.en: Thanks! I rode four stops too far.
方向 — direction. 反方向 — the wrong direction. 坐过 — overshoot your stop. Everyone's done it.

title: Which Subway Exit
desc: Exit A, B, C or D — pick wrong and you're ten minutes from right.

lines.en: Exits A, B, C and D surround you like a choose-your-own-adventure. Pick wrong and walk ten minutes.

lines.hz: 小美，我到站了，哪个出口？
lines.py: Xiǎo Měi, wǒ dào zhàn le, nǎ ge chūkǒu?
lines.en: Xiao Mei, I'm at the station — which exit?
Exit C — you're right at the mall.

lines.py: B chūkǒu ne? hǎoxiàng gèng jìn.
B chūqu shì mǎlù duìmiàn, yào rào.
lines.en: B puts you across the road — detour.

lines.py: hǎo, wǒ zǒu C. nǐ zài jǐ lóu?
lines.en: OK, taking C. Which floor are you on?
Third floor — by the café door.
出口 — exit. 绕 — detour. In a Chinese subway, the exit letter IS the destination.

title: Ordering Pizza
desc: Thirty minutes or free — learn to order it in Chinese.

lines.en: Movie night needs pizza. Phone in the order — and learn the delivery dance.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ yào diǎn yí ge pīsà.
lines.en: Hi, I'd like to order a pizza.

lines.hz: 幸福路十八号，三单元五零二。
lines.py: Xìngfú Lù shíbā hào, sān dānyuán wǔ líng èr.
hǎo de, sìshí fēnzhōng sòng dào.

lines.en: 寸 — inch. 单元 — building unit. 送到 — 'delivered to'. Your address, memorized forever.

title: Chinese Fruits
desc: Durian, dragonfruit, lychee — the fruit stand is a whole new vocabulary.

lines.en: The fruit stand is a rainbow of words you've never seen. Taste first, learn names after.

lines.py: wǒ bù gǎn…… yǒu lìzhī ma?

lines.hz: 有，今天刚到的，十五块一斤。
lines.py: yǒu, jīntiān gāng dào de, shíwǔ kuài yì jīn.

lines.hz: 来一斤荔枝，再来个西瓜。
lines.py: lái yì jīn lìzhī, zài lái ge xīguā.
lines.en: A jin of lychee, plus a watermelon.
斤 — half a kilo, China's everyday weight. 闻着臭吃着香 — smells bad, eats fragrant.

title: Buying Sandals
desc: Summer just started and your feet are melting. Try them on first.

lines.en: Summer just started and your feet are already melting. Sandal time — but try before you buy.

lines.hz: 这双凉鞋有三十七码吗？
lines.py: zhè shuāng liángxié yǒu sānshíqī mǎ ma?
lines.en: Do these sandals come in size 37?

lines.hz: 有，您穿三十七的？我看看。
lines.py: yǒu, nín chuān sānshíqī de? wǒ kànkan.
lines.en: Yes — you wear 37? Let me check.

lines.hz: 有点儿紧，有三十八的吗？
lines.py: yǒudiǎnr jǐn, yǒu sānshíbā de ma?

lines.en: 双 — pair. 码 — size. 紧 — tight. 合適 in China: sizes run small, size up.

title: Ordering Xiaolongbao
desc: The soup is INSIDE the dumpling. Approach with caution.

lines.en: The soup is INSIDE the dumpling. Repeat: the soup is inside. Approach with caution.

lines.hz: 好，一笼八个。还要别的吗？
lines.py: hǎo, yì lóng bā ge. hái yào biéde ma?
lines.en: OK, eight per basket. Anything else?

lines.hz: 再来碗酸辣汤。怎么吃才对？
lines.py: zài lái wǎn suānlàtāng. zěnme chī cái duì?
lines.en: Plus a hot-sour soup. How do you eat them right?

lines.hz: 先咬一小口，把汤吸出来。
lines.py: xiān yǎo yì xiǎo kǒu, bǎ tāng xī chūlai.
lines.en: Bite a small hole, sip the soup out.

lines.py: hǎo—— wā, tàng! dànshì tài hǎochī le.
lines.en: OK— whoa, hot! But so delicious.
笼 — basket (of dumplings). 烫 — burning hot. 蘸 — dip. Everyone burns the first one; everyone.

title: Buying a SIM Card
desc: Data or nothing. Get your phone online in five minutes.

lines.en: No data means no maps, no translation, no dinner delivery. A SIM card fixes everything.

lines.hz: 你好，我要买一张手机卡。
lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng shǒujī kǎ.
lines.en: Hi, I need a SIM card.
How much data do you want?

lines.py: yí ge yuè èrshí G de yǒu méiyǒu?

lines.hz: 好，就要这个。护照在这儿。
lines.py: hǎo, jiù yào zhège. hùzhào zài zhèr.
lines.en: OK, this one. Here's my passport.
流量 — mobile data. 手机卡 — SIM card. Registration requires your passport — don't forget it.

title: Ordering a Steak
desc: Rare, medium, or well done — the three most important words of the night.

lines.en: Rare, medium, or well done? The three most important words of the night.
How would you like it done?
Potatoes or vegetables on the side?
Potatoes. And a glass of red wine.
The steak is so tender — thanks!
几分熟 — literally 'how many parts cooked'. 五分 = medium, 三分 = rare, 全熟 = well done.

title: The Clogged Toilet
desc: It won't flush and the water is rising. Call for backup.

lines.en: It won't flush and the water keeps rising. Time to call for backup.

lines.py: wéi, fángdōng ma? mǎtǒng dǔ le.
yánzhòng ma? shuǐ màn chūlai le ma?
hái méiyǒu, dànshì chōng bù xiàqu.
lines.en: Not yet — but it won't flush.

lines.py: bié zài chōng le! wǒ jiào rén lái xiū.
lines.en: Don't flush again! I'll send someone.
堵 — clogged. 马桶 — toilet, literally 'horse bucket'. 修 — fix. May you never need this episode.

title: Leaving a Tip
desc: The tip that backfired — China doesn't do tips.

lines.en: You left cash on the table — and the waiter chased you down the street. China doesn't do tips.

lines.py: ò, nà shì gěi nǐ de xiǎofèi.

lines.en: A tip? No need, no need!

lines.hz: 我们这儿不收小费。您拿好。
lines.py: wǒmen zhèr bù shōu xiǎofèi. nín ná hǎo.
lines.en: We don't accept tips here. Take it back.

lines.hz: 好吧……那，谢谢你们，饭很好吃。
lines.py: hǎo ba…… nà, xièxie nǐmen, fàn hěn hǎochī.
lines.en: OK… well, thank you — the food was great.
小费 — tip. In most of China, tipping isn't a thing. Your compliments, however, are always accepted.

title: Due This Week
desc: The report was due 'this week'. Which day does that actually mean?

lines.en: 'Due this week' is not a deadline — it's a trap. Nail down the actual day.

lines.py: nà ge bàogào zhè zhōuwǔ yào jiāo.
lines.en: That report is due this Friday.
Friday morning or end of day?

lines.py: xiàbān qián gěi wǒ jiù xíng.

lines.en: OK. Do you want the slides too?

lines.py: méi wèntí, zhōusì wǎnshang gěi nǐ.
lines.en: No problem — you'll have it Thursday night.
Good — don't leave it to the last minute.
交 — hand in. 下班 — off work. 拖 — procrastinate. Deadline vocabulary: the first job skill.

title: Do You Have Class This Afternoon?
desc: The schedule question that decides your entire afternoon.

lines.en: One question decides your whole afternoon — and your nap schedule.
Do you have class this afternoon?

lines.py: yǒu yì jié, liǎng diǎn dào sì diǎn.

lines.hz: 我没课！那四点半喝咖啡？
lines.py: wǒ méi kè! nà sì diǎn bàn hē kāfēi?

lines.en: 节 — measure word for class periods. 老地方 — 'the usual place', the best two words in any language.

title: How Is This Sold?
desc: By the piece? By the jin? By the box? Market math decoded.

lines.en: By the piece, by the jin, or by the box? Market math has its own grammar.

lines.py: àn jīn mài, liù kuài yì jīn.
lines.en: By the jin — six kuai per jin.

lines.py: chéngzi àn ge mài, sān kuài yí ge.
lines.en: Oranges are per piece — three each.

lines.py: hǎo, liǎng jīn píngguǒ, sān ge chéngzi.
lines.en: OK — two jin of apples, three oranges.
怎么卖 — 'how is it sold?' 按 — 'per/by'. One question unlocks the whole market.

title: Washing Clothes on the Road
desc: Day twelve of the trip and every shirt tells a story. Laundromat time.

lines.en: Day twelve of the trip and every shirt tells a story. Find the laundromat.

lines.py: nǐhǎo, zhèr néng xǐ yīfu ma?
lines.en: Hi, can I wash clothes here?

lines.py: néng, zìjǐ xǐ háishi wǒmen xǐ?

lines.hz: 按公斤算，十五块一公斤。
lines.py: àn gōngjīn suàn, shíwǔ kuài yì gōngjīn.
néng, jiā shí kuài. míngtiān shàngwǔ qǔ.
lines.en: Yes — plus ten. Pick up tomorrow morning.

lines.py: hǎo, zhè yì dài dōu gěi nǐ.
lines.en: OK — this whole bag is yours.
洗 — wash. 烘干 — machine dry. 袋 — bag. Fresh socks, fresh start.

title: Where's My Takeout?
desc: Ordered an hour ago. The tracker says 'rider is nearby' for 40 minutes.

lines.en: Ordered an hour ago. Tracker says 'rider is nearby' — for forty minutes. Call someone.

lines.hz: 你好，我的外卖一直没到。
lines.py: nǐhǎo, wǒ de wàimài yìzhí méi dào.
lines.en: Hi, my takeout still hasn't come.
How long ago did you order?

lines.hz: 一个小时了，显示骑手就在附近。
lines.py: yí ge xiǎoshí le, xiǎnshì qíshǒu jiù zài fùjìn.
lines.en: An hour — and it says the rider is nearby.

lines.hz: 我看一下……他好像走错楼了。
lines.py: wǒ kàn yíxià…… tā hǎoxiàng zǒu cuò lóu le.
lines.en: Let me check… he seems to have gone to the wrong building.

lines.py: sān hào lóu, búshì yī hào.

lines.hz: 抱歉，我马上让他过去，五分钟。
lines.py: bàoqiàn, wǒ mǎshàng ràng tā guòqu, wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Sorry — sending him over, five minutes.

lines.py: hǎo, xièxie, fàn hái méi liáng ba……
lines.en: OK thanks — hope the food isn't cold…
骑手 — delivery rider. 下单 — place an order. 走错楼 — went to the wrong building. Classic.

title: Which Train Station?
desc: The city has four stations and your ticket only says a name.

lines.en: The city has four train stations and your driver needs one name. Say the wrong one, miss the train.

lines.py: nán zhàn…… ba? wǒ kàn yíxià piào.
lines.en: South… I think? Let me check the ticket.

lines.hz: 南站和西站差很远，搞错就来不及了。
lines.py: nán zhàn hé xī zhàn chà hěn yuǎn, gǎo cuò jiù láibùjí le.
lines.en: South and West are far apart — get it wrong and you'll miss it.

lines.hz: 那就是南站，四十分钟能到。
lines.py: nà jiùshì nán zhàn, sìshí fēnzhōng néng dào.
láidejí ma? wǒ bā diǎn de chē.
lines.en: Will we make it? My train's at eight.

lines.hz: 来得及，现在才六点四十。
lines.py: láidejí, xiànzài cái liù diǎn sìshí.

lines.en: 来得及 — 'make it in time'. 差很远 — 'far apart'. Always read your ticket BEFORE saying station names.

title: Fast Food
desc: Sometimes you just want fries and zero surprises.

lines.en: Sometimes you don't want an adventure. Sometimes you want fries and zero surprises.
Hi, what can I get you?

lines.hz: 换成雪碧。薯条要大份的。
lines.py: huàn chéng xuěbì. shǔtiáo yào dà fèn de.
lines.en: Make it Sprite. And large fries.
套餐 — set meal. 带走 — 'take away'. 在这儿吃还是带走 — the world's most useful either-or.
